remarks:
Historic Prairie-Style Home in Lockport's High & Locust Street District

Discover the character and spacious design of this 3,720-square-foot Prairie-style home in Lockport's High & Locust Street Historical District.

Thoughtfully updated while retaining its architectural charm, this residence offers gracious living spaces, flexible accommodations, and outstanding outdoor amenities.

The welcoming entry foyer, framed by French doors, opens into a main foyer with marble flooring and an open staircase. Soaring 9.5-foot ceilings enhance the generous living room, featuring a fireplace insert and elegant curved-top shelving. The formal dining room, with hardwood floors and a decorative fireplace, is ideal for entertaining.

A charming parlor adjoining the dining room opens to a private side deck. The butler's pantry offers excellent storage and connects the dining areas to the updated kitchen with new granite countertops and recessed lighting. Beyond the kitchen, a bar and game room with an attached screened room create an inviting setting for gatherings.

The second floor features an en suite primary bedroom with a laundry area and spacious walk-in closet, two additional bedrooms, and another full bathroom.

The finished third floor adds approximately 1,200 square feet, including two bedrooms, a large living area, and a full bathroom—ideal for guests, a home office, or recreation.

Outdoor living includes a covered rear deck, side yard, rear patios, an in-ground pool, and a 2.5-car garage.

Recent improvements include three mini-split heating and cooling systems, 35 energy-efficient windows, replacement doors, garage gutters, recessed lighting, concrete patios, an awning, pool resurfacing, and additional updates.

With historic charm, generous living space, thoughtful updates, and exceptional outdoor amenities, this unique Lockport home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy character and comfort.

Delayed negotiations until October 20th, 2026 at 3:00 PM
